notes.title: MORE CHEESE PLEASE
notes.notes:
Hey taxi lovers,

You know, there's many types of cheese in the world, and a lot of them are good, a lot of them belong on our pizza, which we love and belongs in our bellies. All the time. Almost to the point where someone might say it's unhealthy.

Anyway, where are we going with this? Today there's two important news bits to share with everyone!

[h2]The Rat Update[/h2]

We're launching a [b]FREE[/b] update for everyone, aptly called [b]The Rat Update[/b], where we're introducing you to [b]Michele[/b], a rat denizen of the [b]Pizza Time[/b] level, naturally. Once you pick up Michele, you'll notice that their cheese senses will take over and you'll start seeing cheese all around every Gear-based level. Let Michele snatch them up and he'll reward you with some coins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752170/619ec977d69b3a6547bdf2539ab516ed1415c78c.gif[/img]

[h2]WE'RE DAILY DEALING, BABY![/h2]

It's been a bit over 6 months since we launched and in case you haven't managed to get your hands on the game yet, today you're in luck, as we'll be have a Daily Deal feature on Steam at [b]40% (FORTYPERCENT) off[/b] for a very limited time! [b]Our biggest discount yet![/b]

Grab it now before your pizza gets cold!

[h2]Version 1.2.0 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Game Content[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added Michele, the Cheese-seeking rat
[*] Added a small secret area in the Pizza Time level, where you can find Michele hanging out with friends!
[*] Added cheese around all Gear-based levels, which can only be collected by Michele once you find
[*] him in Pizza Time
[*] We're holiday ready, baby.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Improved the ring color system for clients with gears, so that clients with their gears picked up only show up as gray, and those who haven't will show up as rainbow colored.
[/list]

🐀+🧀=💖

notes.title: New, Definitely Not “Crazy Taxi”, Level!
notes.notes:
Hello creatures. We have lots of exciting news! 

First off - thank you so much for your continued support of our game. We have [b]600+ Overwhelmingly Positive reviews[/b] 🤯. We continue to be blown away by this incredible vrooming community, so thank you times a million kajillion!!! 

Anddd as a thank you and because we’ve had entirely too much pizza at this point - neither of which have anything to do with each other - we’ve decided to make a [b]brand new “Crazy Taxi” inspired level! [/b]

In this level it’s all about time survival and bringing clients from one place to the other. Clear all clients’ requests to win! Crank up the volume and rock out to a few new tracks by various artists including Game & Sound, CRGuitar and Mega Ran!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752170/50cbd7b42dfbd0a466040b11cfb43447afdc88aa.gif[/img]

[b]To access the new content, head over to the Arcade Panik level and locate the Cartridge collectible[/b]! Once you have the collectible you’ll want to vroom over to the Psycho Taxi cabinet and BOOM you’ll be able to enjoy the new level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752170/3602b9acc09942b27778e3b31dd779407e5d3f0d.gif[/img]

[b]If you already own the game the update will automatically be available to you.[/b] And if you don’t already own Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom…WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?! We’re 20% off from now until July 11th! 

In other news, on [b]Friday July 5th Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom will be vrooming at the Summer Games Done Quick event![/b] For more information or to register for the event [url=https://gamesdonequick.com/marathons/clut3zj5r0002xc01yi4t61gf]check out their website[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752170/c7178009537bb6a3f05ca7b38c439f82cb68f525.jpg[/img]

And if you’re hungry for more deets we have a few more patch notes to tantalize your taste buds. We don’t know why you’re licking the game but whatever floats your boat. Just wipe the monitor off when you’re done.

[h2]Version 1.1.0 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Game Content[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a new unlockable level: Psycho Taxi. This level has no gears to collect and it’s all about picking up clients and keeping the timer up!
[*] Added a collectible in Arcade Panik to unlock the Psycho Taxi level.
[/list]

[h3]Speedrun features[/h3]

[list]
[*] With the Speedrun Timer enabled from the Cool Stuff settings, you can now hold the Action button in-game during a Gear pick up in order to have all subsequent Gear pick-up animations sped up.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Unsupported controllers, like a fancy shmancy N64 controller, now display an undefined prompt glyph instead of crashing the game. Yay!
[*] We’ve added one extra pepperoni to the Pizza Time level. But after some internal testing we decided it was overkill and got rid of it.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Missed us? Here's another small patch to address some of the stuff reported by the community!

[h3]Localization:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Updated Japanese localization for better accuracy. Thanks to our Japanese players for the feedback!
[*] Replaced the Japanese font with one that supports all characters.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs:[/h3]

[list]

[*] Fixed an issue with Tosla HQ's unlock cutscene by Morio which didn't display when resetting files. This bug was mostly relevant for speedrunners and was caused by a missing reset on the variable when deleting the file.
[*] Fixed missing colliders at Tosla HQ when render distance was set to low.
[*] Resolved issue where the Golden Propeller wouldn't appear correctly after file resets.
[*] Fixed the Bombeach level achievement trigger when importing the save from the demo.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added prevention measures to ensure the game doesn't freeze when using the Xbox Elite controller.
[*] Excluded UFOs on the Moon level from the auto-checkpoint system to prevent players from getting stuck in a death cycle caused by moving UFOs.
[*] Implemented a no-respawn zone on the rock pillars at the beginning of the Pizza Time level to prevent respawn issues.
[*] Adjusted the teleport position of the taxi on the Moon level when touching the golden watch, so that it teleports on solid ground.
[*] Improved the performance of orange block activation by increasing the iteration speed 10x during portal transitions, preventing delays when teleporting near orange blocks.
[*] Adjusted the taxi's idle time after teleporting cutscenes to improve stability.
[*] Pizza King's mole on his bum is now moved 5px to the left.
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Updated game credits.
[/list]

And remember, kids, don't eat your pizza in the back seat of the taxi. Front seat only!

notes.title: Thanks for everything, creatures!
notes.notes:
We want to thank you all for the tons of positive reviews, amazing playthroughs and overall wonderful response to our little taxi game. The feedback you provided was also crucial for fixing some hiccups we encountered during our first week on Steam. Here’s what’s new! 

[h3]Steam Deck Verified[/h3]

The game is now officially [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b] and runs great, so you’re all more than welcome to take the Yellow Taxi on the road with you. Send us some pics while you’re at it, and let’s make a World Tour happen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752170/321de66940d6da580208bce21a00a0fdc8ee9554.jpg[/img]

[h3]Bug-fixing and achievement tuning [/h3]

Some of you have called us out on our pretty basic achievement titles and descriptions, and instead of making up excuses, we decided to give them another go! If you still don’t like them, we’ll have no choice but to write them out in Italian. Mamma mia! For the full patch notes, complete with all the squashed bugs, scroll all the way down. 

[h3]Hat today, gone tomorrow! [/h3]

Time is running out to snag our exclusive Limited Edition Burger Hat, which will disappear from Morio’s Hat Closet after [b]May 9th, 2024[/b]. Though if you buy the game up until then, you get to keep it [b]forever[/b]! Vroom now, or you’ll miss out on our ridiculous game-breaking hat! 

Also big thanks to everyone who wishlisted the game and helped take our bonkers crown to new heights. <3 

[h3]Trading Cards Incoming[/h3]

We’re turning some of the amazing artwork we received into collectible Steam Trading Cards! Approval is still pending but they’ll be here sooner rather than later. Collect them all before Morio staples selfies of himself over all of them! 

Though it’s been a hectic ride, we still can’t get over all the amazing support we’ve received. Please join our little yellow taxi family on [url=https://discord.gg/ytgv]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/panikarcade]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@yellowtaxigoesvroom]TikTok[/url] so you don’t miss out on all the dumb ideas we’re putting into practice! Read the full patch notes below and have a wonderful pizza-filled day! 

[h2]Version 1.0.5 Patch Notes: [/h2]

[b]Gameplay improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Implemented additional safeguards for the 100% completion cutscene to address issues where chunks are not solid after the taxi is restored to its position.
[*] Provided safeguards for handling controllers, particularly for Xbox Elite controllers, preventing game black-screen and providing specific error messages for debugging.
[*] The Rocket no longer appears in the distance of Granny's Island if the final boss is not defeated yet.
[*] Conveyor belts in Crash Test Industries now have a backup system to ensure that if the taxi is off of a conveyor belt, it stops moving as if it was on one.
[*] Updated Morio's dialogue for unlocking Flip'O'Will.
[*] Improved PICI's explanation of Super Boost.
[*] Added a confirmation pop-up when attempting to delete a file.
[*] Updated a certain character's animation to remove the pooping stance.
[*] Confirmed the presence of colliders at Tosla HQ.
[*] Removed unused funny faces 🤡.
[*] During the Pizza Pepperoni Minigame, respawning at the checkpoint is replaced with using the auto-respawn system to ensure spawning inside the minigame area.
[*] Sewers sign indicating the "inevitable death path" can no longer be destroyed.
[*] Increased the "no respawn" area of giant gears to fix the Starman Castle bug where the taxi would respawn in the sky.
[*] Ensured that the final Tosla level unlock-cutscene plays consistently.
[*] Added extra safeguards for the final Tosla level cutscene to prevent the player from going Out of Bounds.
[*] Updated achievement translations since we got called out by the community 🤬.
[*] Improved Morio's bed sheets to a 600 thread count
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Set the correct flag for an NPC that only wants to engage in conversation.
[*] Fixed a bug where Golden Bunnies in the level were not counted accurately.
[*] Fixed visual stuttering of the camera and the taxi after extended playtime by increasing timer precision.
[*] Fixed chunks in the Time Attack 3 level.
[*] Fixed Achievement TV triggering near PICI, near the Tosla HQ portal.
[/list]

[b]Speedrun features[/b]

[list]
[*] Speedrun timer now continues running even after collecting 100% of the collectibles.
[*] Speedrun timer pauses during the 100% completion cutscene.
[/list]

[b]Accessibility[/b]

[list]
[*] If the "Reduce Flashes" setting is enabled, various elements are now affected:
[list]
[*] The light flickering in Morio cutscene at the start of the game is removed.
[*] Flash during Double Boost removed.
[*] The taxi no longer flashes during the spin of the Flip'O'Will.
[*] Flashing removed from flippable boxes.
[*] Level transitions tinted in a shaded orange instead of rainbow for reduced eye strain.
[/list][/list]

[b]Demo[/b]

[list]
[*] When importing data from a demo, ensured that coins in later levels are in the correct "uncollected" state.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Ok time for some more bug fixes today, making your experience about 4.20% better!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]Bugs[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed missing colliders in the Tosla HQ level
[*] Resolved issue in the Ruined Observatory level where the taxi would respawn at a high altitude due to the auto checkpoint system. This occurred when the respawn location intersected with the giant moving gears, causing the taxi to gain incredible vertical speed.
[*] Attempted to fix conveyor belt issues in Crash Test Industries. 
[*] Implemented additional measures to potentially resolve the bug where the final cutscene would respawn the taxi on an unsolid floor. 
[/list]

The last two bugs we were not able to repro consistently on our end, so please let us know if you still encounter them!

[b]Gameplay improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Added the option to skip the additional loading screen time by pressing the action button, allowing players to bypass the delay intended for reading the "welcome to" text, if already familiar with the game.
[*] Enhanced controller functionality in Photo Mode, allowing faster camera movement.
[*] Made minor UI adjustments for improved clarity.
[*] One NPC now has stomach problems.
[/list]

[b]Speedrun features[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the speedrun timer functionality based on feedback from the speedrunning community. The timer now pauses only during level loading, after defeating the final boss, during the ending credits and during the new game cutscene.
[*] Enabled the speedrun timer to display and operate within the pause menu.
[*] Corrected level title placement in the initial level cutscene to prevent overlapping with the speedrun timer.
[/list]

[b]Demo[/b]

[list]
[*] Importing a demo file now unlocks the Cloud 9 and Bombeach achievements, provided their conditions were met in the demo.
[/list]

[b]Steam Deck[/b]

[list]
[*] Implemented virtual Steam keyboard for accessing cheats in the Big Picture mode or on the Steam Deck.
[/list]

Fun fact: the TAG Lawyer NPC is based off Those Awesome Guys' actual lawyer!

notes.title: Big Demo Update one week before launch because that’s how we roll!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Even though we’re spring powered, it feels like we’re firing on all cylinders with [b]just one week left till launch![/b] One last coat of paint and our tiny taxi is ready to take on the world, but in the meantime, we wanted to say thanks for all the support with a little taste of things to come! 

[h2][b]The Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom free Demo has been heavily updated and is available on Steam, right now! [/b][/h2]

It’s no surface level tune up either, you can expect things like different areas, new camera movements, huge graphics upgrades, tons of quality of life and level design improvements, plus a new minimap! And these barely scratch the surface, full patch notes can be read below, in all their glory. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752170/f9c2797470ac396c56e10bf2b1e0a329d96e9de9.gif[/img]

As we’re gearing up for the final stretch, things are getting chaotic but also very, very rewarding. Thank you all for the interest you’ve shown for our little taxi game and please wishlist if you haven’t already. We even made a special [url=https://twitter.com/PanikArcade/status/1773000204259615044]game-breaking hat[/url] just for you! 

See ya on launch day
You’re the best! 

[h3]Demo version 0.93 patch notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Minimap for levels and sub areas
[*] Lab and Granny’s Island are now treated as 2 different areas.
[*] Camera and taxi now interpolate movement at higher frame rates, resulting in a smoother action were possible.
[*] Added an auto-checkpoint system in certain areas. Traditional checkpoints still serve a purpose for when you completely run out of time, or for Mori-o-trons. Certain areas are not allowing auto-checkpoints. Those areas fall back on traditional checkpoints. Checkpoints still save the time you collected, in time based levels.
[*] Added the possibility to look around
[*] Demo no longer has photo mode (still present in release)
[*] Huge graphics rework:

[list]
[*] New 3d models
[*] New textures
[*] Backgrounds
[*] Vertex painting
[*] New visual effects
[*] Ambient occlusion
[*] Antialiasing
[*] Other stuff I can't remember, as we literally reworked the whole game 
[/list]
[*] Reworked the inside of Morio’s home.
[*] Reworked buildings. Now the taxi is supposed to walk on rooftops by level-design. 
[*] Other game/level design improvements
[*] Removed Arcade Panik from the public demo
[*] Added a bunch of settings
[*] Fixed too many bugs to list them here (or remember hehe)
[*] Many quality of life improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Join the Wishlist drive for our ever-growing Limited Edition Burger Hat!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone[/b],

We’ve been so blown away by all your support that we decided to give out a special treat, made exclusively for our awesome community. The love you’ve shown for our game &[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3I_OBp2EJUI&ab_channel=ThoseAwesomeGuys] launch trailer[/url] means the world to us as we approach the big day! 

[h1][b]Introducing the Limited Edition Burger Wishlist Hat! [/b][/h1]

We’re working on a crowd-sourced in-game hat in the shape of a glorious, towering burger. How big the burger gets, depends on how many of you Wishlist the game before April 9th! Each wishlist goal will unlock a new layer to the Burger Hat.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2011780/

Can you guess any of the upcoming layers from their outline? Wrong answers only. 

One last thing, the[b] Limited Edition Burger Hat[/b] will be available to claim to everyone who buys the game within the first month of launch. After that it’s beyond your reach FOREVER! 

We’ll be back soon with more updates on the hat, and more. 
Byee!

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.69
notes.notes:
Hey hey taxi lovers! 🚕

We've been humbled by your feedback so far and we have an update for the demo build which already incorporates some feedback we got from the community, as well as a new paint job on Morio's lab, since he got bored of the old one!

Here's the full list of changes:

[list]
[*] WASD keys now work in the main menu
[*] Jump timing window is now larger, and it’s overall easier to perform. 
[*] You can now press flip and brake together as well 
[*] (Narrator: I wonder why I hadn't thought of that before hahaha…)
[*] Lab gear is now shining in rainbow colors to avoid confusing it with a gear that can be picked up
[*] Menu text now bounces way less, for readability purposes
[*] Coins lost at death are now 30 instead of 50
[*] Can you reach the top of Morio’s Grandma’s statue? Because we put a little something there :P
[*] Changed Morio’s Home layout to be less reliant on the jump
[*] Flip can now destroy Oil Pumps, as it was always meant to 
[*] Respawn sequence now is faster after 3 deaths, it will skip the “Get Ready, Go” sequence
[*] Granny’s Hub Island portals now stay active after a death
[*] Added the option in the menu for tweaking the master volume
[*] Obfuscated some code to avoid excessive spoilers. Planning some in-house modding support to compensate for that :)
[*] Added a motion blur setting, for people sensitive to low frame rates
[*] Mori-o-tron now takes you to the closest checkpoint if you haven’t activated one already
[*] Morio was bored so he gave the lab a fresh coat of paint
[*] Changed Pici's dialogue about the jump, to make it easier to understand
[*] Fixed a bug with the speedrun timer, which made the timer go slower.
[*] The speedrun timer is also using DOUBLE precision
[*] Fixed a few minor visual bugs after the lab rework
[*] Fences do not block camera anymore
[*] You can now exit out of the game using just your controller buttons
[*] Changed the taxi shadow to a round one for better depth perception
[*] Secret stuff ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752170/c1d5a72104642be91cec0c711b5b519028d84a34.gif[/img]

Pretty cool, right? 😎

Stay vroooooming,

Panik Arcade 🍕

notes.title: Reveal trailer + DEMO, beep beep!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]The time to taxi is almost upon us![/b][/h2]

We're so excited to give you a sneak peek into the wondrous world of YTGV with our new [b]game reveal trailer[/b], aaaaaaaa

[previewyoutube=cUg46fx12uM;full][/previewyoutube]

And to celebrate the announcement, we've just released our [b]official demo![/b] 

Spot the weirdos. Take in the sights. But above all, don’t believe Big Oil’s lies! Just hit that [b]"Play Demo"[/b] button on the Steam page, and get ready to vroom 😎

But what even is a [i][b]Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom[/b][/i]?

Since you asked, we're pretty sure it's a game. You play by driving around the twists and turns of a trippy world, unlock collectibles, collect unlockables and meet lots of weirdos in the process.
Some would call it an arcade platformer, but since we didn't add a jump button, we say it's a bump'n'jump game ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

This is just the first of many blurbs of wondrous news still to come. 

And while we're warming our engines for more, don’t forget to [b]add Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom to your Wishlist to show support![/b]   

🚕 [b]Bon Voyage! [/b]
